name: std::counted_iterator<I>::operator[]

declarations.code:
constexpr decltype(auto) operator[](std::iter_difference_t<I> n) const

    requires std::random_access_iterator<I>;

intro: Accesses the element at specified relative location. The behavior is undefined if n is not less than the recorded distance to the end.
